motive: Aiko approved a forged launch certification file and killed Ito before the scheduled board disclosure threatened her position and criminal exposure.
means: Aiko took the paralytic aerospace paralytic using administrator override and injected Ito beneath the ear with a syringe.
opportunity: Aiko used the scheduled voltage dip and mechanical service key to enter the satellite command bay through the service corridor while Celia was on a call.
true_timeline: 20:21 Aiko authenticated the disputed launch certification file approval from her office.
20:32 Aiko scheduled a load test to produce a voltage dip.
20:58 Aiko used her administrator role to open the aerospace paralytic cabinet.
21:42:50 Celia stepped away for a call, leaving Aiko unobserved.
21:43:19 Aiko entered the service corridor during the voltage dip and opened 4B mechanically.
About 21:45 Aiko injected Ito with paralytic aerospace paralytic.
21:48:03 Aiko exited the corridor, reflected in the display case by her jacket clasp.
